name: poolKit
description: Allocation-conscious bounded object pooling with deterministic ownership, cleanup, and diagnostics.
summary: Allocation-conscious bounded object pooling with deterministic ownership and cleanup.

Waiting.description: A live limit (maxActive) and a bounded waiting queue (maxWaiting, Acquire(onAvailable), CancelWaiting) for objects the host can never free.

Children.description: Cascading release: AttachChild and DetachChild, and children released before their parent.

Deferred.description: ReleaseAfter: release deferred until an animation group finishes.

Generations.description: The generation option and SetGeneration: objects built by a superseded factory are retired instead of reused.
